svg.text: The window is the rack: rails at its sides from the panel to the status bar, the least zoom puts them at the edges. No frame;
devices screwed on, 5 of them here and the units below empty. Rails 59.2 wide each, 20 of it for the numbers; 46.9 of it beside a panel.
The panel itself runs 26.9 over the rail (was 38); its screws 10.2 from its edge and from the LCD.
1U = 128 units (DEV_H) = 1.75″, the rest in proportion: holes 27.4 square (⅜″) at 18.3 · 64 · 109.7 from a unit's top; screws in the top and bottom one.
A 1U face 125.7 high (1.719″): 2.3 between two, on the unit grid. Least zoom here 1.49× the screenshot's: 6.1 units in sight.
Units numbered from the top on both rails, all the way down. Zoom: never less than rails at the window's edges; more is fine (then it scrolls sideways too).
